item_short_desc: The Griffin Travel Shoe Shine Kit is built for uniformed professionals who need to stay inspection-ready wherever duty calls. This all-in-one kit includes 2 tins of black polish, 1 dauber, 1 shine cloth, and 1 shine brush, everything needed for fast, effective leather care tailored to tactical boots, oxfords, and uniform shoes. Compact and portable, the shoe care kit is the perfect solution for travel, field deployment, or daily use on the job.
